methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Candela is a Series C-stage transportation technology company that has raised €129M+ to date. The broader transportation sector includes seven identified private peers—notably Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Slate Auto, and ZeroAvia—though no public comparables exist. The peer set is dispersed across subsectors and valuation tiers, limiting direct comparability.

A peer-median approach was not applicable in this analysis. Despite identifying three same-sector peers in Transportation, none satisfied the necessary filters for a robust comparable set: zero peers matched Candela's Series C stage, zero fell into adjacent financing rounds, and zero clustered within a similar valuation tier. Achieving statistical reliability would require a minimum of three datapoints meeting stage or tier criteria; the fragmented peer universe did not support this threshold. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise and misrepresent Candela's specific positioning.

The analysis therefore cannot be anchored to triangulated valuation methods given data constraints. A defensible range would require either (1) expanding the peer set through deeper private market data collection focusing on same-stage transportation hardware or software companies, (2) applying venture capital method modeling if near-term revenue or margin assumptions are available, or (3) conducting an asset-based or comparable transaction analysis if acquisition or financing data for similar businesses exists. Key uncertainties include the stage and timing of the next financing event, burn rate relative to raised capital, and whether Candela's technology subsector (marine electrification) has sufficient peer depth for future benchmarking.
